entries.symptom: Synthetic save migration preflight failed because the transform appeared to set save_version=2 but validation still read save_version=1.
entries.root_cause: JsonValue::set is append-only and JsonValue::require returns the first matching key, so adding a second save_version created duplicate schema keys and left the original version authoritative.
entries.fix: Added fail-closed JsonValue::replace for existing object fields and changed migration transforms to replace save_version rather than append a duplicate key.
entries.verification: Full canonical preflight passed on commit dda0248bde9f730710bb630e1b62acb755235ef3 after the repair; all 23 simulation tests passed including ordered migration fixtures.
entries.residual_risk: Future migration transforms can still misuse append-only set for other existing schema keys unless they follow the same replace-existing-field rule; schema migrations should review every modified existing key for replacement semantics.
